name: Barricade, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 5, psychic 5, sorcerer/wizard 5
Duration 1 minute/level (D) or until discharged

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as per barricade, except as above and the amount of damage it reduces is equal to your caster level. Additionally, the total amount of damage it can absorb over the course of its duration before being overloaded is equal to 50 + 5 times your caster level.
